newsitem.title: FINLAND: CULTOR SELLS SILAGE PRESERVATIVE OPS.
newsitem.headline: CULTOR SELLS SILAGE PRESERVATIVE OPS.

text.p: Finnish food group Cultor Oy said in a statement on Friday it was selling its silage preservatives operations in Finland to Kemira Oy's chemicals arm for an undisclosed sum.
The sale comprised two units with net sales of 40 million and 42 million markka respectively and the agreement would come into force on December 31, it said.
"The parties have agreed not to publish the transaction prices," Cultor said.
The units sold were a 50 percent stake in SSV-Sailonta Oy and Cultor's Suomen Rehu subsidiary's silage preservatives operations in Finland.
"Suomen Rehu's silage preservatives business in Norway, Swden and in the Baltic countries is excluded from the transaction," it said.
